source.author: cic
source.text: Quam ob rem quis hoc non iure miretur summeque in eo elaborandum esse arbitretur, ut, quo uno homines maxime bestiis praestent, in hoc hominibus ipsis antecellat?
source.text_original: Quam ob rem quis hoc non iure miretur summeque in eo elaborandum esse arbitretur, ut, quo uno homines maxime bestiis praestent, in hoc hominibus ipsis antecellat?
source.text_english: For this reason, who would not rightly wonder at this, and think that the greatest effort must be made in it, namely that in that one thing by which men most especially surpass the beasts, he himself should excel other men?

reuse.author: hier
reuse.text: nam cum idcirco, ut ait praecipuus orator, homines bestiis differamus, quod loqui possumus, qua laude dignus est, qui in ea re ceteros superat, in qua homines bestias antecellunt?
reuse.text_original: nam cum idcirco, ut ait praecipuus orator, homines bestiis differamus, quod loqui possumus, qua laude dignus est, qui in ea re ceteros superat, in qua homines bestias antecellunt?
reuse.text_english: For since, as the foremost orator says, we differ from beasts for this reason, that we are able to speak, with what praise is he worthy who surpasses the rest in that very thing in which men excel beasts?
